deploybot: Deploy started -> prod-usw2 · tag=v2.7.3-rc4 · commit=9f3b2ac · initiating canary (10% traffic)
maya: Noticed a flurry of 503s in canary at ~30s in. seen in /generate endpoint.
liam: Confirming 503 spike, also seeing increased lat p95 on runtime-api. Can reproduce locally with same tag.
sre_oncall: Pulling logs and metrics, looks like kv-cache misses spiked after model swap. Prior tag v2.7.2 stable.
maya: Can we pause rollout and pin back to v2.7.2?
sre_oncall: I'm going to trigger a rollback. Will use the bot command to revert traffic and pin previous tag.
nana (typo correction) **(note)**: ignore — false alarm
sre_oncall: Running: ```deploybot rollback --env prod-usw2 --from-tag v2.7.3-rc4 --to-tag v2.7.2 --reason "canary 503s/kv-cache regression"```
deploybot: Rollback initiated · request_id=rbk-2401234567 · reverting traffic to v2.7.2 · job: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rbk-2401234567
liam: Thanks — switching alerting to post-rollback watch.
maya: Reverting now, I see canary errors tailing off as traffic shifts. Good to pin once stable.
sre_oncall: Rollback progress: 10% -> 50% -> 100% traffic restored to v2.7.2, no more 503s observed.
deploybot: Rollback completed · request_id=rbk-2401234567 · status=success · duration=01m12s · new-live-tag=v2.7.2 :white_check_mark:
sre_oncall: Pinning v2.7.2 to prevent automated rollforward. Command: ```deploybot pin --env prod-usw2 --tag v2.7.2 --reason "prevent autoretry after canary regression"```
deploybot: Pin applied · env=prod-usw2 · pinned_tag=v2.7.2 · pin_id=pin-2401234567
toni: Opening a short incident and adding notes to release tracker: cause suspected kv-cache behavior after model change. Will request a deeper rollback analysis.
nana: I'll add an evaluation job to reproduce kv-cache hit/miss with v2.7.3-rc4 and compare configs.
maya: For release notes: mark v2.7.3-rc4 as reverted and add "investigating kv-cache regression".
liam: Follow-up action: hold any further automated deploys for the release window until we root cause.
sre_oncall: Post-rollback watch for 30m. If any regressions, escalate.
deploybot: Summary: rollback completed, v2.7.2 live, traffic 100%, pin in place. Links: incident=https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2401234567 · rollout_job=https://deploys.redwood.internal/rbk-2401234567
maya: Thanks everyone. Will coordinate postmortem and an updated canary plan for the next attempt.
liam: ":thumbsup:"
